rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken equivalent, especially when the name is presented with doubt, criticism, or distance.

example.english: The so-called expert is always talking nonsense on TV; you'd be in trouble if you believed him.
example.traditional: 所謂嘅專家成日喺電視度亂噏，信佢就弊喇。
example.jyutping: so2 wai6 ge3 zyun1 gaa1 seng4 jat6 hai2 din6 si6 dou6 lyun6 ngap1 seon3 keoi5 zau6 bai6 laa3

rows.note: Use this neutral construction when N is simply identified by the name A, without implying that the name is false or unsuitable.

example.english: This little shop, so-called “Granny Tofu Pudding,” is packed every morning.
example.traditional: 呢間叫做「阿婆豆腐花」嘅小店，朝早成日坐滿人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 giu3 zou6 aa3 po4 dau6 fu6 faa1 ge3 siu2 dim3 ziu1 zou2 seng4 jat6 co5 mun5 jan4
